name: Eatle
abilities: Eats almost anything and converts it into energy
Green energy beam fired from his horn (cut a Legerdomain mountain in half, pinned Lucubra-enhanced Vilgax)
Enhanced strength (crushed Captain Nemesis's glove, shoved Ship-Julie through walls)
Enhanced durability (survived Nemesis's glove laser and a falling building)
Fast running; horn used as a battering ram
weaknesses: Compulsively eats things against his interests (ate the Tenn-Speed wreck)
summary: A beetle-horned alien who chews up matter and fires it back as a laser from his horn; a blue metallic bruiser in UA and a proper rhinoceros beetle in OV.
traits: Mouth takes up most of his upper body in UA
Ate Kevin's bumper because it was 'delicious'
notableFeats: Confronted Vilgax at the Seal (A Knight to Remember)
Destroyed Addwaitya's water creature and cut a Legerdomain mountain in half (Enemy of My Frenemy)
Fought Captain Nemesis (Catch a Falling Star)
Battled Ultimate Vilgax alongside Sir George (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 1)
Retrieved the Nuclear Fusion Device from Ester (Hot Stretch)

appearances.designNotes: Ten-foot dark-blue metallic humanoid; huge silver serrated mouth spans his upper body/back, small swivelling head with a tall front horn and short rear horn, silver belt/wristbands/soles, four claws; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

notableEpisodes: Let's Do the Time War Again
appearances.designNotes: Beetle-like: grey skin with dark-green spiked armour down face/back/limbs, rounded toothy underbite jaw hinged by two spikes, blue tongue, long forked front horn (rhinoceros beetle), two toes, three fingers, green clothing on the bare torso; Omnitrix on chest.

scoring.rationale: Mid-tier bruiser with a real gun: eating matter powers a horn beam that halved a floating mountain and held Vilgax down; tough enough to take Nemesis's lethal glove laser. Needs to eat to charge and sometimes eats the wrong thing.

notes: UA and OV designs are radically different (metallic humanoid vs beetle) - both infobox images are series-labelled.
UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
